messages:
maya: Quick heads-up — planning canary deploy Tue 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC. This touches api, runtime, console, router. Need to lock pinned versions and canary rollout percentages by EOD today.

dan: +1. What pinned matrix are you thinking?

maya: Proposed pins: api v1.9.4, runtime v2.4.0-rc3, console @sha:8f4a2d, router v0.12.1. Canary plan: 5% -> 20% over 30m, then 50% if metrics stable.

priya: FYI runtime v2.4.0-rc3 includes the KV cache change we discussed. We should gate runtime canary until api has the compatibility header.

alex: Confirming API change: added header `X-RW-Compat: 2` (backwards compatible but changes batching heuristic). We'll include a feature flag to opt-in per-route.

maya: Great — we'll pin api to v1.9.4 (with feature-flag off for now) and runtime to rc3. Router needs to be aware of the new header so routing rules don't split on it.

samir: Ops note: change window reserved Tue 02:00-04:00 UTC. infra oncall: @samir, @dan. If latency spikes > 300ms p95 for 5m, auto-rollout pause.

deploy-bot: deploy request accepted: canary-start @1768012345, targets: api:v1.9.4 runtime:v2.4.0-rc3 console:sha-8f4a2d router:v0.12.1, canary:5%

priya: Also, locking versions in release notes and console UI is important — customers on Dedicated may need explicit pin instructions. I'll add a note to release notes draft.

d an: (typo) Dan: I'll add the migration note to infra runbook and ensure router config `sticky_session=false` is set during canary.

alex: Test checklist before canary: 1) api header present 2) runtime KV cache smoke 3) console fallback UI 4) router route table config. I can run 1-2. Priya can run 3.

priya: I'll test console fallback locally and post logs. Expect to finish by 18:00 PT.

maya: If all green, we'll start canary. Rollback plan: mirror canary reversal to previous versions within 5m; if console errors > 2% or model regressions detected by quality monitor, full rollback.

ops-bot: Scheduled change window created: Tue 2026-03-23 02:00 UTC -> 2026-03-23 04:00 UTC. Pager channel: #eng-oncall.

d an: Quick pin note — for Dedicated customers add `runtime_version: 2.3.x` fallback in spec so traffic doesn't break if we auto-fallback to older runtime.

maya: Good call. Priya please add that to release notes and the rollout playbook.

priya: Added to notes and playbook. Pushed diff: https://git.redwood/release-notes/patch/234 (internal).

alex: Running a pre-canary smoke with synthetic load now. Will report in 10m.

deploy-bot: canary 5% started at 1768012500. Monitoring knobs: p95 latency, error-rate, model-quality-regressions.

alex: Smoke looks OK — p95 within 10% of baseline, errors 0.1%.

maya: Awesome. Proceed to 20% after 15m if metrics stable.

samir: Reminder: if router shows >10% 502s, abort and rollback.

alex: 15m in — metrics stable, bumping to 20%.

deploy-bot: canary increased to 20% at 1768012600.

maya: Leaving this thread open for post-canary notes. If anything hits thresholds, call rollback and ping #incidents. :rocket:
